lint.msg: 203 words. Long prompts bury the action; keep it under ~150 and lead with what happens.
monitors: models invent letters on anything readable. Turn it away, keep it blurred, add real text in the edit.
bright, epic: says nothing executable. Name the lens, the distance, one light source and its direction.
